title: Compute selection rules
action: Apply the loaded representation formulas from Saulevich et al. (1970) to the irreducible representation data of space group C6v4 to compute the direct product decompositions for all pairs of stars and irreducible representations. Save the complete set of selection rules.
description: Selection rules as direct product decompositions
output_schema: JSON object with 'star_products' (array of {star1, star2, decomposition: [{star, multiplicity}]}) and 'ir_products' (array of {ir1, ir2, decomposition: [{ir, multiplicity}]}) using paper notation (k0, k3, F1, etc.)

title: Compute Clebsch-Gordan coefficients for U4×U4
action: Using the same irreducible representation matrices, compute the Clebsch-Gordan coefficients for the direct product U4 × U4 → U1 + U4 + Δ1 + Δ5 via the formula from Saulevich et al. (1970). Produce a table matching the ordering of the wavevector index combinations (k1/k2/k3) as presented in the paper.
description: Clebsch-Gordan coefficient table for U4 × U4
output_schema: JSON array of rows, each row with fields: i (string: k1/k2/k3), j (string: k1/k2/k3), U1_k1, U1_k2, U1_k3, U4_k1, U4_k2, U4_k3, Delta1_k1pp, Delta5_k1pp_1, Delta5_k1pp_2. Entries are strings representing complex numbers or symbolic expressions (e.g., '1/sqrt(2)', 'eta/sqrt(2)')
